sections.title: Dividend Policy
sections.excerpt:
DIVIDEND POLICY We currently intend to retain future earnings, if any, for use in operation of our business and to fund future growth. We have never declared
or paid any cash dividends on our capital stock and do not anticipate paying any cash dividends in the foreseeable future. Payment of cash dividends, if any, in the future will be at the discretion of our board of directors and will depend on
then-existing conditions, including our financial condition, operating results, contractual restrictions, capital requirements, business prospects and other factors our board of directors may deem relevant.
